newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best downgrades Mercury Finance units.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best downgrades Mercury Finance units.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said Monday that it has lowered the ratings of Mercury Finance Co's insurance operations to "B" (Adequate).
Best said the downgrade reflected Mercury's default on $17 million in commercal paper which came due on Jan 31, and concerns over its ability to refinance other short term debt.
Mercury faces about $100 million of commercial paper obligations that will come due this week.
The ratings affected are those of Lyndon Property Insurance Co, Lyndon Life Insurance Co and Gulfco Life Insurance Co.
